spans.s:
प्र-√ घट् Ā. -घटते, to exert one's self, devote one's self to (loc.), Bhaṭṭ.;
to commence, begin, ib.
प्र-˚घटक (ifc.) a precept, rule, doctrine, Cat.
a precept, rule, doctrine, Kap., Sch. (cf. प्र-घटक).
प्र-˚घटा f. the rudiments or first elements of a science
प्र-˚घटा—विद् m. = शास्त्र-गण्ड, L.
a general reader (but not a profound one), W. (cf. छात्त्र-ग्˚).
n. (√ हन्) a place or a terrace before a house, Hcar. (also ˚घान or ˚घन), L.
an iron mace or crowbar, L.
a copper pot, L.
प्र-˚घाण m. n. = or v.l. for ˚घण, Hcar.; L.
the trunk of a tree, L.
प्र-˚घन m. = prec.
also v.l. for प्रथन, Phaseolus Mungo, L.
प्र-˚घान See ˚घाण.
प्र-˚घात॑ m. a blow, stroke, TS., Sch.
a battle, fight, L.
the edging of a garment, ŚBr.
प्रा—घात w.r. for प्र-घ्˚, L.
a devourer (pl. N. of false gods), L. (cf. Pāṇ. ii, 4, 37; 38)
N. of a Rākṣasa, MBh.
of a monkey follower of Rāma, R.
N. of one of the Mātṛs attending on Skanda, MBh.
प्र-˚घास See वरुण-प्रघास॑.
प्र-˚घासि॑न् (VS.) mfn. voracious.
प्र-˚घास्य᳙ (TS.) mfn. voracious.
प्र-√ घातय P. ˚यति (Caus. of प्र-√ हन्), to strike, kill, Divyāv.
a guest, visitor, L. (prob. w.r. for प्राघुण).
(Prākṛt for प्रा-घूर्ण; cf. प्रहुण) a visitor, guest, Kathās.
प्र-√ घुष् Caus. -घोषयति, to cause to announce aloud, proclaim, MBh.
प्र-˚घुष्ट mfn. sounding forth, Var.
प्र-˚घोष m. sound, noise, BhP. (also -क, L.)
N. of a son of Kṛṣṇa, BhP.
प्र-˚घोषिन् m. ‘roaring’, N. of the 9 classes of the Maruts, MW.
turning round or rolling violently, W.
wandering, roaming, ib.
a guest, visitor, L. (prob. w.r. for प्राघ्˚).
(lit. ‘one who goes forth deviously’) wanderer, guest, Pañcat.
प्र-√ घृ P. -घरति, to ooze out, Divyāv.

प्र-√ घृष् P. -घर्षति, to rub to pieces, Kauś.;
to rub into, anoint, Suśr.
प्र-˚घर्ष m. rubbing, anointing, Car.
प्र-˚घर्षण m. grinding, crushing, destroying, Kāv.
प्र-˚घर्षण n. rubbing, a remedy for rubbing in or anointing, Car.
प्र-˚घृष्ट mfn. rubbed in, embrocated, anointed, Suśr.
प्रा—घर्म-स॑द् mfn. sitting in a region of fire or light, RV. vi, 73, 1 (Sāy.)
प्रा—घार m. sprinkling, aspersion, L.
प्रा˚घुणक (Pañcat.) m. id.
प्रा˚घुणिक (Bhām.) m. id. (˚णिकी-√ कृ, to make a visitor to, cause to reach; कथा मम श्रवन-प्राघुणिकी-कृता, ‘the tale was made to reach my ears’ i.e. ‘was communicated to me’, Naiṣ.)
प्रा˚घूर्णक m. id. (v.l.)
प्रा˚घूर्णिक m. id., L. (v.l.)
प्रा˚घूर्णिका f. hospitable reception, Vet.
